title: Measurement of LLM’s Philosophies of Human Nature
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure aspects of faith or religion. It measures LLM attitudes toward human nature across six dimensions: Trustworthiness, Altruism, Independence, Strength of Will and Rationality, Complexity of Human Nature, and Variability in Human Nature.
base_benchmarks: Wrightsman's Philosophies of Human Nature Scale (PHNS)
findings: The paper's findings are not related to religion. The key findings are that LLMs exhibit a systemic lack of trust in humans, and this distrust correlates negatively with the model's intelligence level.
